item.title: Kilmar Ábrego García, target of Trump’s immigration crackdown, lands in Spain after ‘leaving happy’
item.description:
Ábrego García chose to depart from US after previously being deported to El Salvador due to ‘administrative error’

Kilmar Ábrego García, the Salvadoran national whose mistaken deportation turned him into a symbol of Donald Trump’s mass deportation efforts, has landed in Spain.

Ábrego García arrived in Madrid on Wednesday after leaving the United States of his own volition. Prior to his departure, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents met him at the airport and removed his ankle monitor, according to We Are CASA, a Maryland-based advocacy group.

item.title: 53 incoming House Democrats to boycott Harvard orientation in support of graduate students’ strike
item.description:
‘We have been informed that to attend your event we would be required to cross a union picket line,’ the Democrats say

  • US politics live – latest updates

Fifty three newly elected members of Congress told Harvard University on Tuesday that they will boycott an informal orientation program at Harvard’s Kennedy School next month in support of the school’s striking graduate students union.

In a letter to the university’s administrators, the incoming House Democrats expressed thanks for their invitations to the Bipartisan Program for Newly Elected Members of Congress, in which more than 800 members have participated in since 1972.
